Method of Attack: Malicious Windows 10 builds hide dropper, injector, and clipper malware in system directory and EFI partition to evade detection. Dropper (iscsicli.exe) mounts EFI partition and copies malware files. Injector (recovery.exe) injects clipper DLL into legitimate system process via process hollowing. Clipper malware monitors clipboard for cryptocurrency wallet addresses and substitutes them with attacker-controlled addresses. Malware evades detection by checking for analysis tools and avoiding substitution if detected.
Attack Vector: Pirated Windows 10 ISO images distributed via torrents containing malware hidden in EFI partition and system directory
